events.fact: Xero OAuth 2.0 authentication endpoints are: Authorization endpoint `https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize`, Token endpoint `https://identity.xero.com/connect/token`, Issuer `https://identity.xero.com`. PKCE (S256) is supported.

Xero developer pricing shifted in March 2026 to a tiered model: Starter (5 connections, free), Core (50 connections, $35 AUD/mo), Plus (1,000 connections, $245 AUD/mo), Advanced (10,000 connections, $1,445 AUD/mo), Enterprise (Unlimited connections, custom pricing).
App certification requires onboarding 10 active customer connections (not demo companies) that have made API calls in the last 30 days, passing a security assessment, and annual recertification.

Xero transitioned to granular scopes for the Accounting API. Apps created on or after March 2, 2026, must use granular scopes (e.g. accounting.invoices, accounting.payments instead of broad accounting scopes). Existing apps have until September 13, 2027 to migrate.
Xero access tokens expire in 30 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after 60 days of inactivity or if not used/rotated, and use a rotating refresh token model.

events.fact: Xero redirect URI rules require absolute URIs, support up to 50 unique redirect URIs per application, and do not allow wildcards.

Xero Custom Connections (machine-to-machine integration using client credentials grant) are available for single-organization internal/automation use, bypassing user authorization and refresh token management.
Xero API rate limits per connection are: 5 concurrent calls, 60 calls per minute, and 5,000 calls per day (1,000 for Starter tier). App-wide limit is 10,000 calls per minute.

events.fact: Xero updated its developer terms effective March 2026 to explicitly prohibit using data obtained from Xero's APIs to train AI/ML models.
Xero app certification and security assessment reviews typically take about 5 working days for initial assessment and 5 to 10 working days for review of answers.
